title: Lazy Loading — Companion Demo & Snippets
title_es: Lazy Loading — Demo y Snippets Companion
description: Runnable lazy loading demo: an offline IntersectionObserver image gallery with generated placeholders, a React.lazy + Suspense example with error boundary, and a TanStack Query infinite scroll hook with cursor pagination.
description_es: Demo ejecutable de lazy loading: galería de imágenes offline con IntersectionObserver y placeholders generados, ejemplo de React.lazy + Suspense con error boundary, y hook de infinite scroll con TanStack Query y paginación por cursor.
